dedupe_keys.name: arcep electronic communications market observatory revenues traffic subscriptions investment

description: The observatory of electronic communications publishes Arcep's time series of the activity of French telecom operators, collected through its surveys of operators and aggregated for the whole market. Quarterly series give retail revenues, voice, SMS and data traffic and subscriptions, including mobile SIM cards by overseas département; annual series add investment, employment and the business market; price indices are monthly and published once a year. Coverage: France, national totals, from 2000 to 2024 in the current release. Format and access: XLSX tables on data.gouv.fr and on arcep.fr following a publication calendar; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: market-level aggregates only; definitions change over time, such as the counting of machine-to-machine SIMs. Simulation uses: demand and traffic growth series for capacity planning of telecom networks, and economic context for investment and resilience studies. Related records: the Arcep FTTH deployment data give network build-out, and ITU ICT statistics give international comparisons.
